node.title: Re^2: special characters in parsed json rendering badly in browser
node.author: TheloniusMonk
node.doctext: \x refers to hex encoding, <strike>so \x{2018} is a two-byte encoding of chr(32) and chr(30) (32 decimal = 20 hex). So it's one of the 16 bit character encodings, though from this alone I am unsure which.</strike> See replies for more info.
